_source: Pipistrel Velis Electro HB-SYQ, Markus's photo of 3 Jul 2025 (sources/velis-panel-notes.md): two rows of round instruments — ASI, EFIS, altimeter; Power / RPM, slip ball, vario / flight timer — and on the right the GPS map above the EPSI 570C.

layout._note: clear of the mission title, clock and KEYS at the top left

config._source: Markus, from HB-SYQ (2026-11-12): 0 at 12 o'clock, then 20 … 160 clockwise; no green, yellow or red — a thick white band ~47–52 and a narrow white arc ~47–80 (the placards: V_S0 46, V_S 53, V_FE+1 81). Spacing: the real dial looks wider in the middle — even spacing here, to check.
Markus (2026-11-12): three pointers and a dual pressure scale (hPa and in. Hg) — the C172's dial with a third pointer
the round Power / RPM unit on the photo — the ring 0 … 8 (× 10 kW, to confirm), the screen kW and rpm; its values stand-ins (core/epsi.js)
the slip indicator (winter) on the photo — a black ball in a curved tube between L and R, in a round case
the round vario / flight-time unit on the photo — the ring ±10 m/s (2000 fpm), 0 at 9 o'clock; the screen fpm and the flight time
